The '''Linuri system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Doldur sector/Legends|Doldur sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Linuri]].
